svg.title: Prior, likelihood, and posterior for the seed lot
svg.desc: The Beta(2, 2) prior, the scaled binomial likelihood from 26 germinations in 40 seeds, and the Beta(28, 16) posterior drawn on one axis.
svg.text: 26 of 40 seeds germinated: three curves on one axis
pi, the germination rate of the lot
likelihood from 26 of 40, scaled to area 1
The posterior sits between the prior and the likelihood and much closer to the likelihood. It
is far narrower than the prior, and narrower than the likelihood by only two percent, a margin
too small to see here. Its mean, 0.6364, falls just below the sample proportion 0.65.
